Smart Parking Management System (Abstraction & Encapsulation)
Problem Statement

You are required to design a Smart Parking Management System using Object-Oriented Programming principles in C++.

The system must demonstrate:
Encapsulation (data members must be private)

Abstraction (public methods exposing only n

System Requirements

Create a class ParkingLot that manages parking slots and vehicles.

Private Data Members (Encapsulation)

int totalSlots → Total parking slots available

int availableSlots → Currently available slots

int parkedVehicles → Number of vehicles currently parked

double ratePerHour → Parking rate per hour

double totalRevenue → Total money collected

Public Methods (Abstraction – System Messages)

void initialize(int slots, double rate)

Initializes parking lot with total slots and rate per hour.

bool parkVehicle()

Parks one vehicle if slot available.

Returns true if successful, otherwise false.

bool removeVehicle(int hours)

Removes a parked vehicle.

Calculates bill = hours × ratePerHour.

Updates total revenue.

Returns true if successful.

void displayStatus()

Displays:

Total Slots

Available Slots

Parked Vehicles

Total Revenue (2 decimal precision)

Input Format (User Based)

First line:
totalSlots ratePerHour

Second line:
numberOfOperations

Next N lines:
Each operation is one of:

P → Park vehicle

R hours → Remove vehicle after given hours

S → Show status

Output Format

If parking fails → print "Parking Full"

If removal fails → print "No Vehicles Parked"

For successful removal → print "Bill: <amount>"

For status → print formatted details
